script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let v be the acting enemy of arg, then the register of arg's 'parent'.
If not v's 'canTransit', then
  If this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "currBattlePhaseTurn") is more than 1, then set v's 'canTransit' to true.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
If this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "totalBattlePhaseTurn") is 12, then executer uses the move labelled "doom" and stop.
Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of executer with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
Let ability be a weighted random move of executer other than withoutAbilityList.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "apoptosis" on executer.
If ability is not ability2, then executer uses ability and stop.
Let list3 be [{abilityTag: "apoptosis"}, {abilityTag: "dispel", abilityOptions: {skipMessage: true}}].
If executer's 'statusAilments' → has-any-by-bundle-id with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.ESNA_AND_SLOW), then append {abilityTag: "esna_slow", abilityOptions: {skipMessage: true}} to list3.
Executer uses ability2 with its cast time and then list3.

flow.text: Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "totalBattlePhaseTurn") is 12
Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of executer with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
Let ability be a weighted random move of executer other than withoutAbilityList.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "apoptosis" on executer.
Executer uses ability2 with its cast time and then list3.
